newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Veritas DGC rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Veritas DGC rated buy.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw said it initiated coverage of Veritas DGC Inc with a buy rating.
-- In a report issued September 20, Rodman said Veritas management has aggressive plans to grow the company, and external capital likely will be needed.
-- Cash-flow is set to expand dramatically as the company adds capacity and further improves operating margins, Rodman added.
-- A 12-month price target of $25 a share was set.
-- Veritas shares on Monday were up 3/8 at 16-1/8.
-- Veritas is engaged in seismic data acquisition, seismic data processing, multi-client data sales, and exploration and development information services.
